commands.pixel_readback: ruby -e 'require "json"; require "base64"; require "digest"; require "open3"; root="/private/tmp/xomo-rc1719-workflow.gSnfq4"; projects=%w[baseline moved undone redone].to_h { |n| [n,JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(root,n+".xomoproject")))] }; layers=projects.transform_values { |j| j["layers"].find { |l| l["id"]==j["selectedLayerID"] } }; rgba={}; dimensions={}; layers.each { |n,l| png=Base64.strict_decode64(l["imageData"]); w,h=png.byteslice(16,8).unpack("N2"); bytes,error,status=Open3.capture3("magick","png:-","-depth","8","rgba:-",stdin_data:png); abort error[0,300] unless status.success? && bytes.bytesize==w*h*4; rgba[n]=bytes; dimensions[n]=[w,h] }; bw,bh=dimensions["baseline"]; mw,mh=dimensions["moved"]; shift=10; shifted=mh==bh && mw==bw+shift && (0...bh).all? { |y| rgba["moved"].byteslice((y*mw+shift)*4,bw*4)==rgba["baseline"].byteslice(y*bw*4,bw*4) }; transparent=(0...mh).all? { |y| (0...shift).all? { |x| rgba["moved"].getbyte((y*mw+x)*4+3)==0 } }; puts JSON.generate({runtime_versions:projects.transform_values { |j| j["appVersion"] },formats:projects.transform_values { |j| j["formatVersion"] },dimensions:dimensions,undo_png_equal:layers["baseline"]["imageData"]==layers["undone"]["imageData"],undo_rgba_equal:rgba["baseline"]==rgba["undone"],undo_frame_equal:layers["baseline"]["frame"]==layers["undone"]["frame"],redo_full_project_equal:File.binread(File.join(root,"moved.xomoproject"))==File.binread(File.join(root,"redone.xomoproject")),whole_source_shifted_10px:shifted,left_10px_transparent:transparent,files:projects.keys.to_h { |n| p=File.join(root,n+".xomoproject"); [n,{bytes:File.size(p),sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}] }})'
commands.reopen_readback: ruby -e 'require "json"; require "digest"; require "open3"; root="/private/tmp/xomo-rc1719-workflow.gSnfq4"; original=JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(root,"redone.xomoproject"))); reopened=JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(root,"reopened.xomoproject"))); strip=lambda { |j| j.reject { |k,v| k=="historyTitles" } }; pngs=%w[edited reopened].to_h { |n| [n,File.binread(File.join(root,n+".png"))] }; decoded=pngs.transform_values { |png| bytes,e,s=Open3.capture3("magick","png:-","-depth","8","rgba:-",stdin_data:png); abort e[0,250] unless s.success?; bytes }; puts JSON.generate({project_fields_equal_excluding_history:strip.call(original)==strip.call(reopened),original_history:original["historyTitles"],reopened_history:reopened["historyTitles"],export_dimensions:pngs.transform_values { |p| p.byteslice(16,8).unpack("N2") },export_png_equal:pngs["edited"]==pngs["reopened"],export_rgba_equal:decoded["edited"]==decoded["reopened"],export_rgba_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(decoded["edited"]),files:%w[edited.png reopened.png reopened.xomoproject].to_h { |n| p=File.join(root,n); [n,{bytes:File.size(p),sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}] }})'
